title: Wood Adirondack Patio Chair Bench With Center Coffee Table, Perfect For Lounging And Relaxing Outdoors Carbonized
body_html:
Features:

  • - Traditional Adirondack outdoor seating set with 2 seats and a middle table
  • - Perfect for outdoor porch, garden, patio, riverside, and etc.
  • - Made of solid and weather-resistant fir wood
  • - Reclined fan back slat back and wide seat
  • - Center table for placing drinks or books
  • - Assembly required

Specification:

  • - Color:Carbonized
  • - Material: Fir
  • - Overall Dimension: 61.5" W x 32.75" D x 37.5" H
  • - Each Seat Size: 18" W x 20" D
  • - Seat to Floor Height: 15"
  • - Backrest Size: 16.25" W x 26.5"H
  • - Table Size: 12.25" W x 20.5" D
  • - Weight Capacity: 330 lbs (Per Seat), 44 lbs (Table)
  • 1 x 2-seat Bench
  • 1 x manual
